{"candidates":[{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Materializes the hour projection before aggregation to explore repeated-expression evaluation while reading only the required trips column. Retains COUNT(*), aliases, DuckDB types, NULL groups, hour boundaries, timezone behavior, and anomalous dates. Proposed for fixed external validation; no results claimed.","sql":"WITH pickup_hours AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour
  FROM trips
)
SELECT hour, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM pickup_hours
GROUP BY hour"}]}
